comparison.objective: Tip a full-width pan of sand evenly across all 12 riffle-splitter chutes; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load balancing, level-lip control, continuous tipping, and granular-flow distribution versus small-tool insertion, collar adjustment, counterholding, locking, and machine cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Title/body imply even feeding of all 12 chutes, but omit distribution tolerance, spill limit, retained mass, and terminal pose. Candidate has explicit energy, velocity, stroke, impact, and drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Granular pouring and level-pan coordination do not test adjustable damping or lock retention; missing splitter thresholds do not suggest duplication.
